text:
Jordan Lee: opening a thread  we've had multiple asks to make 429s and 503s more actionable for clients. current payloads are inconsistent across runtimes. propose a compact taxonomy + small hint surface.
Priya Patel: agree we need a taxonomy. proposal: top-level HTTP mapping stays (429,503,500) but add a small `reason` enum and optional `retry_after`. keep cardinality tiny: reason in [quota, throttle, overload, model_unavailable].
Ibrahim Khan: runtime impl notes: headers are the lowest-cost path. suggested headers: `X-RW-Err` (enum), `X-RW-Retry` (seconds). body `error_hint` JSON block only when `Accept: application/json` or SDKs request it.
Mei Wong: SDKs: prefer deterministic parsing order: headers -> body. we should publish full examples and a changelog entry. also prefer `X-RW-Err` values be stable strings (no internal codes).
Jordan Lee: what about exposing subcodes for billing/quota buckets? that risks PII and topology leaks. we could expose `reason_subtype` but only under sampling.
Priya Patel: telemetry side: add two dims: `err_reason` and `err_surface_version`. keep sampling for `reason_subtype` at 0.1% by default. pre-aggregate for high volume. also add a metric `client_error_rate_by_reason` (1m window).
Rachel O'Neill: console UX: badge by `reason`, banner for tenants hitting `err_reason=quota` with CTA to billing. if `reason_subtype` present show a drilldown (sampled). runbooks per reason: /runbooks/quota, /runbooks/throttle.
Ibrahim Khan: rollout plan: FF `err_surface_v3` default=false. steady rollout: opt-in 5% for 48h, 25% for 4 days, 100% after 2 weeks. dedicated clusters first, then hosted. will include a kill switch.
Jordan Lee: deprecation: mark opaque bodies as deprecated in docs, keep backwards compatibility for 3 months, then remove. communicate to customers via console banner and changelog email.
Priya Patel: metrics and alerts: add an alert `err_reason=quota AND client_error_rate > 2% over 10m` -> paging. ensure we don't create high-cardinality indexes; only allow sampling-controlled subtypes in raw logs.
security-bot: security check reminder: ensure no tenant identifiers, prompt content, or model weights in any emitted hint. route ids must be hashed if included in sampled hints.
Mei Wong: SDK changes: read headers first, fallback to body `error_hint`. add helper `isRetryable(err)` that maps reasons -> boolean and suggested backoff windows. ship patch versions for python/js/go.
Ibrahim Khan: PR will add header emission + conditional body + FF + sampling toggle for `reason_subtype`. tests: header precedence, sample toggle, and no PII leak.
Jordan Lee: can we standardize text for clients for non-English locales in console? Mei can add translation keys.
Mei Wong: yup: keys like `console.error.badge.quota` and `console.error.explain.quota_long`. also include copy for SDK error messages.
metrics-bot: config saved: new metric `client_error_rate_by_reason` created. ingest sampling=default 0.5% for subtypes.
Priya Patel: ops note: storage cost analysis looked fine with sampling, but re-run if adoption increases. add ops-runbook section for FF rollback.
Jordan Lee: action items: Ibrahim draft runtime PR + FF (due EOD), Mei update SDKs + changelog (T+2 days), Priya update metrics and alerts, Rachel wire console badges. security review before 25% rollout.
Jordan Lee: TL;DR: keep HTTP codes, add tiny stable enum header + optional retry seconds, optional body `error_hint` for SDKs, sample any high-cardinality fields, feature-flagged rollout, docs + console comms.
